$comment: Service overlay for compliance-rules.json service_overlays.pr. The engine gate merges these rules for service pr. src/overlay.ts implements the same checks for tests and local pre-checks.

rules.message: Sender name and company are in the footer; US and CA also need a postal address.
Price-sensitive content for a listed client needs a client_legal claim approval.
Canadian journalists need basis casl_business_exemption, express_casl or implied_casl.
French-language outlets in Quebec get French pitches.
Politics, religion and similar topics need client_legal approval.
Published text names a human editor (EU AI Act Article 50 editorial-responsibility exemption).
Every claim id is in the approved claims for the market. Same effect as engine G-CLAIM-APPROVED.
The journalist was pitched by a Pith client in the last 14 days.
